## iPhone 13 crashes or stops responding to anything

A common frustration: your iPhone 13 suddenly does nothing. You try to swipe, press buttons, but your device seems to be completely frozen. Sometimes it even seems to still be on (you might hear a sound or feel vibrations), but you can’t make any progress. Especially very irritating if you have a call appointment scheduled with your mom or boss, but that’s a worst case scenario! Your iPhone 13 is just completely stuck and can’t be turned off. This happens more often than you think, especially after software updates or with heavy use. [...] ## iPhone 13 mini battery problems

Small phone, big annoyance. The iPhone 13 mini is known for its compact size, but unfortunately also for its battery that sometimes disappears as quickly as your motivation on Monday morning. At ThePhoneLab, we regularly get reports from mini users who find that their device gives up mid-day, even if they don’t use it heavily.

### Why is that?

The compact body automatically means a smaller battery as well. Combine that with a few iOS updates, more intensive apps and some years on the counter, and you get: fast drain, slow charge and a frustrating battery condition.

### What can you do? [...] ## iPhone 13 (Pro) Screen remains black

Some users experience their iPhone 13’s screen becoming completely unresponsive or remaining black while the device is on. This could be due to software issues or a faulty screen. If you have an upcoming call with your boss, this can be so irritating that you may want to use your phone as a baseball. Don’t panic! We have some solutions for you!
